Overview - Company Information
Contoso, Ltd is a multinational retail company that builds, deploys, and manages generative AI and agent-based solutions by using Microsoft Foundry.

Existing Environment - Identity Environment
Contoso uses Microsoft Entra ID for identity management, authentication, and authorization capabilities that enable agents to access organizational resources and services. Contoso recently formed a new AI engineering team named Agent1Dev Team to optimize and maintain existing AI solutions. The team collaborates with solution architects, DevOps engineers, and security engineers to design, implement, monitor, and secure AI applications. Contoso also has a team named Agent1Test Team that is responsible for validating AI solutions before solution deployments.

Generative Environment
Contoso has a Microsoft Foundry deployment that contains two projects named Project1 and Project2.

Project1
Project1 contains a customer support agent named Agent1 that assists customers with product inquiries and troubleshooting requests. Agent1 uses a base model deployment. A safety evaluation pipeline is NOT enabled. Tool invocation approval workflows are NOT enabled. Conversation memory constraints are NOT configured. Agent1 interacts with customers by using digital support channels and answers general questions about Contoso products. Project1 is deployed to an Azure region located in the European Union (EU). Agent1Dev Team will use Project1 to optimize and maintain Agent1.

Project2
Project2 contains a deployed video generation model. The marketing department at Contoso has access to Project2 and plans to use the model to develop a video creation solution. Development of the solution is incomplete.

Data Environment
Contoso stores product-related information in Azure resources that support AI applications. The Azure environment contains an Azure Blob Storage account named storage1 that stores product detail sheets for all the Contoso products. The product sheets include specifications, feature descriptions, and product support information that Agent1 can use to answer customer questions. The product sheets are stored in the PDF format.

Problem Statements
Agent1 has only general knowledge of the Contoso products. A recent chat interaction with Agent1 was analyzed for sentiment. The results of the analysis have NOT been processed yet. Agent1 does NOT use the detailed product information in the product sheets stored in storage1 when responding to customer questions. The finance department reports that vendor invoices must be reviewed manually to ensure that the invoices match the terms defined in vendor contracts. The invoices contain tables, logos, and varied layouts that make the documents difficult to process consistently.

Requirements - Planned Changes
Contoso plans to implement a solution for Project1 that analyzes vendor invoices by evaluating both visual layout and textual content so invoice details can be verified against vendor contract terms. Contoso will update the base model deployment used by Agent1 and standardize the model version to ensure continuity and consistent responses. Agent1 must retrieve and use detailed product information from product sheets stored in storage1. An indexing solution must enable Agent1 to answer customer questions. The video creation solution must be completed.

Technical Requirements
The model deployment used by Agent1 must support scalable, high-throughput generative AI workloads and dynamically scale to handle variable customer support traffic, without requiring reserved throughput capacity. Product sheets must be processed by an indexing pipeline that enables semantic and vector search. Responses generated using product sheet information must be relevant, complete, and accurate. Agent1 must answer natural-language questions about product details. The model version used by Agent1 must remain consistent to ensure stable responses. Data processed by the model must remain within the EU.

Security and Compliance Requirements
API keys must NOT be used to access Foundry-deployed models. Access to Azure resources must follow least privilege. Developers must authenticate to Microsoft Foundry resources by using Microsoft Entra authentication. Access to Project1 must be assigned to Agent1Dev Team by using security group SC_Agent1_Dev and to Agent1Test Team by using security group SC_Agent1_Test. Agent1 must never reveal customer information, even if a document containing customer data is added erroneously to the product-sheet repository. Product sheets might contain images with embedded text, and Agent1 must be protected from malicious instructions hidden within images.

Business Requirements
Users interacting with Agent1 must have a personalized experience in future interactions, including retaining conversation context and recalling relevant information from previous interactions. Agent1 must answer questions only about products sold by Contoso.

You need to configure the model deployment for Agent1 to meet the technical requirements. What should you configure? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area. Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: Deployment type: Standard; Version update policy: Upgrade once a new default version becomes available
options.B: Deployment type: Standard; Version update policy: Opt out of automatic model version upgrades
options.C: Deployment type: Global Standard; Version update policy: Once the current version expires
options.D: Deployment type: Global Provisioned; Version update policy: Opt out of automatic model version upgrades

explanation: Standard phù hợp với nhu cầu biến động mà không cần thông lượng đặt trước; tắt tự động nâng cấp phiên bản giúp giữ phiên bản mô hình ổn định.

Question 8

You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains a customer support agent built by using the Foundry Agent Service.
The agent uploads user-provided screenshots to Azure Storage through a ticketing tool and receives a blob URL for additional reasoning.
You need to use image moderation during agent runs and prevent harmful content from being returned during runs. Azure AI Content Safety must access the images by using the blob URL. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.
What should you configure for Content Safety? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

Guardrails options:
Select Tool call and set Action to Block.
Select User input and Output and set Action to Annotate.
Select User input and Tool response and set Action to Annotate.
Select User input, Output, Tool response, and Tool call and set Action to Block.

Storage access options:
Storage account access keys
A user-assigned identity that is assigned the Storage Queue Data Contributor role
A system-assigned managed identity that is assigned the Storage Blob Data Reader role
A system-assigned managed identity that is assigned the Storage Blob Data Contributor role

Select the correct Guardrails/Storage access configuration combination.

options.A: Guardrails: Select Tool call and set Action to Block; Storage access: A user-assigned identity assigned the Storage Queue Data Contributor role
options.B: Guardrails: Select User input and Tool response and set Action to Annotate; Storage access: A system-assigned managed identity assigned the Storage Blob Data Contributor role
options.C: Guardrails: Select User input, Output, Tool response, and Tool call and set Action to Block; Storage access: A system-assigned managed identity assigned the Storage Blob Data Reader role
options.D: Guardrails: Select User input and Output and set Action to Annotate; Storage access: Storage account access keys

explanation: A là đúng. Để kiểm duyệt nội dung độc hại liên quan đến hình ảnh trong toàn bộ agent run và ngăn nội dung đó được trả về, cấu hình tất cả nguồn liên quan (user input, output, tool response và tool call) với hành động Block. Content Safety chỉ cần đọc hình tại blob URL, nên system-assigned managed identity có vai trò Storage Blob Data Reader đáp ứng nguyên tắc đặc quyền tối thiểu. B dùng access key và chỉ Annotate nên vừa không dùng xác thực keyless vừa không chặn nội dung. C cấp quyền Contributor nhiều hơn nhu cầu đọc và Annotate không ngăn nội dung độc hại. D chỉ bao phủ tool call và vai trò Queue không thể đọc blob.

Question 9

You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains three agents as shown in the following table.

Name | Description
TriageAgent | Classifies incoming customer requests
PolicyAgent | Answers policy questions by searching internal content
ActionAgent | Creates or updates tickets by calling an HTTP API

You need to orchestrate the agents to ensure that the customer requests meet the following requirements:
Support a deterministic, step-based process that uses conditional branching and shared state across the agents.
Optionally trigger a ticket action based on the triage result.
The solution must minimize development effort.
What should you include in the solution?

options.A: threads and runs without a workflow
options.D: separate agent runs coordinated in the application code

explanation: A là đúng. Workflow cung cấp thứ tự bước xác định, rẽ nhánh theo điều kiện và trạng thái dùng chung giữa các bước agent mà cần ít code tùy chỉnh. Workflow có thể chạy TriageAgent trước, gọi PolicyAgent khi cần và chỉ gọi ActionAgent dựa trên kết quả phân loại. Chỉ dùng threads và runs không cung cấp cơ chế điều phối cần thiết. Group chat phù hợp với tương tác cộng tác, không mang tính xác định. Điều phối các run riêng trong application code có thể làm được nhưng cần nhiều công sức phát triển hơn.

Question 12

You have an Azure Speech in Foundry Tools resource that hosts a custom speech to text model deployed to a custom endpoint. An agent uses the endpoint to perform real-time speech recognition.
You are approaching the expiration date of the custom speech to text model.
What is the expected behavior when the model expires?

options.A: Speech recognition requests will continue to use the expired custom model until the model is removed manually.
options.B: Speech recognition requests will fall back to the most recent base model for the same locale.
options.C: Speech recognition requests will return a 4xx error until a new custom model is deployed.
options.D: The custom model will be deleted automatically when the model expires.

explanation: C là đúng. Khi custom speech-to-text model đã triển khai hết hạn, các request đến custom endpoint sẽ chuyển sang dùng base model mới nhất cho cùng locale. Endpoint không tiếp tục phục vụ custom model đã hết hạn, không nhất thiết trả về lỗi 4xx chỉ vì custom model hết hạn, và việc hết hạn không tự động xóa custom model.

You need to handle throttling to reduce call failures and improve reliability under load. The solution must remain within the service and model limits.

options.A: Implement a retry policy that uses exponential backoff and jitter.
options.B: Create a new thread and retry the calls immediately.
options.C: Spit uploaded content into smaller files.
options.D: Reduce the number of registered tools.

explanation: C là đúng. HTTP 429 cho biết yêu cầu đang bị throttling. Retry với exponential backoff và jitter ngẫu nhiên sẽ giãn các lần thử lại theo thời gian, tránh việc nhiều request cùng retry đồng loạt, từ đó tăng độ tin cậy mà vẫn tôn trọng giới hạn của service và model. Retry ngay lập tức có thể làm throttling nặng hơn. Số lượng tool đã đăng ký và kích thước file tải lên không trực tiếp xử lý tình trạng model bị giới hạn tốc độ request.

Sampling và trace-sampling policy quyết định giữ lại bao nhiêu trace, còn KQL filter truy vấn telemetry đã thu thập; không lựa chọn nào trong hai loại đó capture nested operation hoặc ghi tool-call metadata.

question:

You have a Microsoft Foundry project that contains an agent. The agent uses threads and file uploads and calls an Azure OpenAI model deployment.
During load testing, calls intermittently fall and return an HTTP 429 rate limit exceeded error. Some user uploads fail and generate an HTTP 400 file size exceeded error.
You need to mitigate the errors and reduce call failures. The solution must remain within the service and model limits.
What should you do to resolve each error? To answer, drag the appropriate actions to the correct errors. Each action may be used once, more than once or not at all. You may need to drag the split bar between panes or scroll to view content.
NOTE: Each comet selection is worth one point.

options.A: HTTP 429: Split content into smaller files before uploading the files; HTTP 400: Increase tenant-wide quotas.
options.B: HTTP 429: Implement exponential backoff and jitter in the retry logic; HTTP 400: Split content into smaller files before uploading the files.
options.C: HTTP 429: Use additional agent tools to reduce the message size; HTTP 400: Implement exponential backoff and jitter in the retry logic.
options.D: HTTP 429: Increase tenant-wide quotas; HTTP 400: Move large content to files and use file search.

explanation: A là đúng. HTTP 429 là throttling, nên retry với exponential backoff và jitter ngẫu nhiên để giãn retry và vẫn nằm trong service/model rate limit. HTTP 400 file size exceeded là vi phạm giới hạn kích thước request, nên cần tách content thành file nhỏ hơn trước khi upload. Tăng tenant-wide quota không trực tiếp xử lý intermittent rate-limit response trong giới hạn service/model hiện tại, và các action khác không giải quyết lỗi upload size cụ thể này.

question:

question:

You have a Microsoft Foundry project.
You need to create a customer support agent that meets the following requirements:
•Grounds responses only in company policy documents stored in curated repositories
•Retains customer preferences across separate chat sessions
How should you configure the agent? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

options.A: Knowledge grounding: Embed the policy documents directly into the agent instructions. Memory: Retain user preferences in the state of the client application.
options.B: Knowledge grounding: Configure retrieval from approved data sources. Memory: Enable agent memory that uses persistent storage.
options.C: Knowledge grounding: Configure retrieval from approved data sources. Memory: Use orchestration-managed session context.
options.D: Knowledge grounding: Upload the policy documents directly to the agent. Memory: Use orchestration-managed session context.

Orchestration-managed session context không duy trì qua các phiên khác nhau, còn state phía client không phải là bộ nhớ bền vững của agent.

question:

Nếu độ đầy đủ chưa đạt, ứng dụng có thể retry hoặc tạo lại phản hồi trước khi trả về. Temperature và presence_penalty chủ yếu ảnh hưởng hành vi sinh nội dung, không kiểm tra độ bao phủ thông tin cần thiết. Thay bằng model nhỏ hơn cũng không phải cách cải thiện completeness.

question:

question:
You have a custom named entity recognition (NER) project in Azure Language in Foundry Tools for support tickets. The schema for the project contains an entity type named ContactInfo.
In tagged training files, ContactInfo is used for phone numbers, email addresses, and social media handles.
Model evaluation shows low precision for ContactInfo, including false positives in which nearby text is extracted as ContactInfo.
You need to improve the precision of the project.
What should you do before retraining the model?

options.B: Add more support tickets as training data and label more ContactInfo entities.
options.C: Replace ContactInfo by using Phone, Email, and SocialMedia entities. Relabel every matching span.
options.D: Lower the confidence threshold for ContactInfo.

explanation: D là đúng. ContactInfo đang gộp các mẫu có đặc điểm và ngữ cảnh khác nhau: số điện thoại, email và social-media handle. Tách thành các entity cụ thể rồi gắn nhãn lại mọi span giúp model có tín hiệu huấn luyện rõ hơn và giảm false positive từ phần text lân cận. Giảm threshold thường tăng recall chứ không tăng precision. Thêm ví dụ cho cùng một nhãn quá rộng hoặc auto-labeling không giải quyết vấn đề thiết kế schema mơ hồ.

question:
You are building a text-to-speech solution that uses Azure Speech in Foundry Tools to read instructions from the script in a text file.
You discover that the solution often pronounces technical terms incorrectly.
You need to prevent the incorrect pronunciations. The solution must minimize development effort.
What should you do?

options.A: Use Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) to specify phonemes.
options.B: Use Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) to apply say as rules.
options.C: Use Speech Synthesis Markup Language (SSML) to adjust the prosody of the voice.
options.D: From Speech Studio, train a custom neural voice

explanation: B là đúng. SSML phonemes cho phép chỉ định chính xác cách một từ hoặc thuật ngữ kỹ thuật phải được phát âm, nên trực tiếp ngăn việc phát âm sai với công sức triển khai tối thiểu. Phần tử say-as thay đổi cách diễn giải text, ví dụ ngày tháng hoặc số, nhưng không phải cơ chế điều khiển phiên âm chính xác cần ở đây. Prosody chỉ điều chỉnh tốc độ, cao độ và âm lượng. Huấn luyện custom neural voice tốn nhiều công sức hơn, còn Whisper là model speech-to-text chứ không phải text-to-speech.

You need to use the Azure Custom Vision API to help detect common faults.

Chỉ train classifier sau khi đã có ảnh được gắn nhãn. question:
You are developing a new sales system that will process user-generated video and text from a public-facing website.
You plan to notify users that their data has been processed by the sales system.
Which responsible AI principle does this help meet?
explanation: B là đúng. Thông báo cho người dùng rằng video và text do họ tạo được hệ thống xử lý giúp họ thấy rõ AI system xử lý dữ liệu của mình như thế nào. Điều này hỗ trợ nguyên tắc responsible AI là transparency. Fairness liên quan đến kết quả công bằng, inclusiveness tập trung vào khả năng tiếp cận và sự tham gia, còn reliability and safety liên quan đến hành vi an toàn, đáng tin cậy của hệ thống.

question:

Dịch vụ này giảm công sức phát triển vì các khả năng đó đã được cung cấp sẵn. question:

When reviewing activity you see greater than expected search query volumes. You suspect that the query key is compromised.
You need to prevent unauthorized access to the search endpoint and ensure that users only have read only access to the documents collection. The solution must minimize app downtime.
Which three actions should you perform in sequence? To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.

options.A: 1. Delete the compromised key. 2. Add a new query key. 3. Change the app to use the new key.
options.B: 1. Regenerate the primary admin key. 2. Change the app to use the secondary admin key. 3. Delete the compromised key.

options.D: 1. Change the app to use the secondary admin key. 2. Regenerate the secondary admin key. 3. Add a new query key.

explanation: A là đúng. Trước hết tạo query key thay thế, cập nhật app dùng query key read-only mới đó, rồi mới xóa key bị lộ. Trình tự này duy trì khả năng hoạt động của dịch vụ đồng thời loại bỏ unauthorized access. Admin key cấp quyền quản trị và không đáp ứng yêu cầu người dùng chỉ có quyền read-only với document collection. Xóa key bị lộ trước có thể gây downtime không cần thiết cho ứng dụng.

question:
HOTSPOT
-
You are building a model to detect objects in images.
The performance of the model based on training data is shown in the following exhibit.

Use the drop-down menus to select the answer choice that completes each statement based on the information presented in the graphic.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: The percentage of false positives is: 25. The value for the number of true positives divided by the total number of true positives and false negatives is: 100.
options.B: The percentage of false positives is: 100. The value for the number of true positives divided by the total number of true positives and false negatives is: 25.
options.C: The percentage of false positives is: 0. The value for the number of true positives divided by the total number of true positives and false negatives is: 25.
options.D: The percentage of false positives is: 0. The value for the number of true positives divided by the total number of true positives and false negatives is: 77.2.

explanation: A là đúng. Exhibit hiển thị precision là 100%. Precision = TP / (TP + FP), vì vậy giá trị 100% có nghĩa không có false positive: 0%. Biểu thức TP / (TP + FN) là recall và exhibit hiển thị recall là 25.0%. Giá trị 77.2% là mAP, không phải recall.

question:
You are developing an application that will use Azure AI Search for internal documents.
You need to implement document-level filtering for Azure AI Search.
Which three actions should you include in the solution? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

options.A: Retrieve the group memberships of the user
options.C: Send access tokens from Microsoft Entra ID, with the search request.
options.E: Supply the groups as a filter for the search requests
options.F: Add allowed groups to each index entry

explanation: A, E và F là đúng. Để thực hiện document-level security trimming, lưu allowed group ID của mỗi document trong một index field. Khi query, lấy group membership của user hiện tại rồi đưa các group ID đó vào OData filter của search request. Nhờ vậy chỉ trả về document mà user được phép xem. Tạo một index cho mỗi group không có khả năng mở rộng, còn lấy toàn bộ group là không cần thiết. question:

You need to add a single built-in multimodal content extraction skill to the Azure AI Search skillset. The solution must meet the following requirements:

Document Extraction không cung cấp output đa phương thức theo layout như yêu cầu. question:
HOTSPOT
-
You are creating an enrichment pipeline that will use Azure AI Search. The knowledge store contains unstructured JSON data and the text from scanned PDF documents.
Which projection type should you use for each data type? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.A: JSON data: Table projection. Extracted text data: Object projection.
options.B: JSON data: Table projection. Extracted text data: File projection.
options.C: JSON data: File projection. Extracted text data: Table projection.
options.D: JSON data: Object projection. Extracted text data: Object projection.

explanation: A là đúng. Object projection lưu enriched content dưới dạng JSON object trong Azure Storage, phù hợp với JSON phi cấu trúc và text được trích xuất từ document. Table projection dùng cho dữ liệu có dạng quan hệ/bảng được lưu trong Azure Table Storage. File projection dùng cho binary content như normalized image hoặc file khác, không phù hợp với extracted text trong tình huống này.
